_comment: THE ONE LIST of the reasons SecurityInsight holds a report back ON PURPOSE at its last complete result (#902). Every reader goes through it: the engine (engine/_shared/SI-HoldKinds.ps1 -- the stored sidata.RaReportStatus.HoldKind, the uplink item, the mail, the heartbeat Warnings) and the web app (SI.Management.Core/Holds/HoldKinds.cs, embedded). A new kind = one entry here + its two codes in errors.locked.json (code: information, cause class held-last-good; escalationCode: the same report held escalateAfterDetailedRuns Detailed runs in a row, cause class held-too-long). acceptEmpty: an Admin may accept the source as empty for good, per report (only a kind that means a SUCCESSFUL read of zero rows). A test fails when code emits a kind that is not here.
